title: Gully's card
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Gully gives Wood a Christmas card. Homemade. A walrus in a Santa hat, on a napkin. Wood pins it to the corkboard beside the yearbook photo, where the walrus already is.

panels.composition: The bedroom. WOOD with a folded napkin. BARNABY under the table.

image.prompt: a young man in his bedroom holding a folded paper napkin, a small dog under the drawing table, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The napkin open: a walrus in a Santa hat, ballpoint, Gully's line. 'HAGS. — G.' No — 'MERRY. — G.'

image.prompt: close on a paper napkin with a ballpoint drawing of a walrus in a Santa hat and a short signed note, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood pinning it beside the yearbook photo. The walrus in the sweater vest is on the photo's page already, from 1998.

image.prompt: a young man pinning a napkin to a corkboard beside a yearbook photograph, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The corkboard: two walruses, a year apart, the same hand. Wood's finger on the older one.

image.prompt: close on a corkboard with two ballpoint walrus drawings pinned side by side a year apart, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Two walruses. Gully's line is the strip's other line.
